534.error_description: Error in the HOMING procedure of the Tinting Valve
534.resolution: Verify correct operation of the two photocells and correct movement of the stepper motor.

535.error_description: Error in the HOMING procedure of the Tinting Turning Table
535.resolution: Verify correct operation of the photocell, make sure that there is at least one flag on the table, and verify correct movement of the stepper motor.

584.error_description: Engagement error of one of the two photocells during Valve HOMING
584.resolution: Check operation of each Valve photocell, the Valve stepper motor wiring, and the metal nameplate alignment.

633.error_description: Tinting Pump Home photocell not engaged at the end of pump step movement, never engaged within the expected time or number of steps, or not engaged during Tinting Table movement
633.resolution: Check Home photocell and stepper motor operation.

634.error_description: Valve HOME photocell not engaged during Tinting Table movement, not engaged at the end of the Homing procedure, or valve closed during dispensing
634.resolution: Verify Valve HOME photocell and stepper motor operation.

733.error_description: Overcurrent on a Tinting Pump stepper motor driver jumper
733.resolution: Verify the Pump wiring and operation of the L6482H driver on the MMT board.

734.error_description: Overcurrent on a Tinting Valve stepper motor driver jumper
734.resolution: Verify the Valve wiring and operation of the L6482H driver on the MMT board.

735.error_description: Overcurrent on a Tinting Table stepper motor driver jumper
735.resolution: Verify the Table wiring and operation of the L6482H driver on the MMT board.

738.error_description: Current circulating in the Dosing Roller Conveyor is higher than the threshold set in the MMT board driver, or overtemperature was detected on the driver
738.resolution: Check the connection and wiring of the Dosing Roller Conveyor on the output reserved on the MMT board.

739.error_description: Current circulating in the Input Roller Conveyor is higher than the threshold set in the MMT board driver, or overtemperature was detected on the driver
739.resolution: Check the connection and wiring of the Input Roller Conveyor on the output reserved on the MMT board.

740.error_description: Current circulating in the Unloading Roller Conveyor is higher than the threshold set in the MMT board driver, or overtemperature was detected on the driver
740.resolution: Check the connection and wiring of the Unloading Roller Conveyor on the output reserved on the MMT board.

792.error_description: Logic error in the Tinting Pump process statuses, including the Valve, or in the received formula parameters
792.resolution: Check the sent formula parameters. If the problem persists, request a Tinting Firmware update.

793.error_description: Logic error in the Tinting Table process statuses

795.error_description: Logic error in the process statuses of the Roller Conveyors and Lifters

842.error_description: Overcurrent or overtemperature in the driver that controls the Loading or Unloading Lifter, or in the Loading Lifter Roller Conveyor on the MMT board
842.resolution: Check the connection and wiring of the Loading or Unloading Lifter, or of the Loading Lifter Roller Conveyor, on the MMT board.

896.error_description: Error during machine RESET while checking the correctness of Humidifier 2.0 parameters
896.resolution: Check the correctness of the parameters sent with the DIAG_SETUP_HUMIDIFIER_TEMPERATURE_PROCESSES command.

898.resolution: Check the connection between the HUTTS Temperature Sensor housing board and the MMT board. If the problem persists, replace the board and/or the connection cable.

907.error_description: Timeout expired during Table Homing or during positioning to a circuit
907.resolution: Verify the Table stepper motor wiring, the Table characteristic parameters sent with the UPDATE_TINTING_TABLE_SETTINGS command, and operation of the Table photocell.

908.error_description: The reference mark found during Table HOMING differs from the theoretical value by more steps than the configured tolerance
908.resolution: Verify that there is a reference mark on the Table, that the Table characteristic parameters are correct, and that the Table photocell operates correctly.

909.error_description: A circuit that needs to be cleaned is not enabled, or a circuit to be positioned is not present in the positional table
909.resolution: Check that the circuit has been enabled and that Self-Learning has been performed correctly.

911.error_description: Tinting Table Self-Learning procedure error: at the start, the Table is not on the reference mark, the Table photocell is not engaged, the number of circuits found is greater than 16, or the number of circuits found in one rotation direction differs from the other
911.resolution: A Reset must be successfully completed before performing Self-Learning. Check Tinting Table photocell operation.

912.error_description: Tinting Pump characteristic parameters are incorrect
912.resolution: Verify the set parameters and send the UPDATE_TINTING_PUMP_SETTINGS command again.

913.error_description: Tinting Table characteristic parameters are incorrect
913.resolution: Verify the set parameters and send the UPDATE_TINTING_TABLE_SETTINGS command again.

914.resolution: Pump parameters may be missing. If the MMT board has been replaced, load the Tinting Pump parameters with the UPDATE_TINTING_PUMP_SETTINGS command.

915.resolution: Table parameters may be missing. If the MMT board has been replaced, load the Tinting Table parameters with the UPDATE_TINTING_TABLE_SETTINGS command.

916.error_description: Incorrect parameters in the peripheral setting command
916.resolution: Verify the set parameters and send the command to set the peripheral units again.

917.resolution: Brush parameters may be missing. If the MMT board has been replaced, load the Brush parameters with the UPDATE_TINTING_CLEANING_SETTINGS command.

918.error_description: The Tinting Pump Home photocell is engaged when it should not be engaged during HOMING, or during Recirculation or Dispensing when the circuit is already engaged
918.resolution: Verify Pump and Pump Stepper Home photocell operation.

919.error_description: The Tinting Pump Coupling photocell is in an incorrect state: engaged when it should not be engaged, or not engaged when it should be engaged
919.resolution: Verify Pump and Pump Stepper coupling photocell operation. Verify the Pump characteristic parameters sent with the specific command.

920.error_description: Tinting Table test failed: the starting position is not on the reference mark, no circuit has been detected, the number of detected circuits is greater than 16, the position of at least one detected circuit in one direction differs from the opposite direction by more steps than the configured threshold, the position of at least one detected circuit differs from the Self-Learning position by more than the configured threshold, or the map of detected circuits differs from the software configuration
920.resolution: Perform a Reset and try the Table Test again. Verify Tinting Table photocell operation, check consistency between the circuits physically present on the Table and those configured in the software, try Self-Learning again, or increase the Table position tolerance by sending the Table parameter configuration command again.

922.error_description: Product carriage out of position when the machine is not in Diagnostic mode
922.resolution: Move the carriage back into position. Verify the carriage microswitch wiring on the MMT board.

923.error_description: Refill panel open on the Tinting Table when the machine is not in Diagnostic mode, or when the machine is in Diagnostic mode and an operation other than Tinting Table rotation is being activated
923.resolution: Close the panel. Verify the panel microswitch wiring on the MMT board.

924.error_description: No load on the output reserved for the Brush on the MMT board
924.resolution: Check the connection and wiring of the Brush on the output reserved on the MMT board.

925.error_description: Current circulating in the Brush is higher than the threshold set in the MMT board driver, or overtemperature was detected on the driver
925.resolution: Check the connection and wiring of the Brush on the output reserved on the MMT board.

930.error_description: No load on the output reserved for the Air Heater on the MMT board
930.resolution: Verify the connection and wiring of the Air Heater on the MMT board.

931.error_description: Current circulating in the Air Heater is higher than the threshold set in the MMT board driver, or overtemperature was detected on the driver
931.resolution: Verify the connection and wiring of the Air Heater on the MMT board.

932.error_description: No load on the output reserved for the Brush Motor on the MMT board
932.resolution: Verify the connection and wiring of the Brush Motor on the MMT board.

933.error_description: Current circulating in the Brush Motor is higher than the threshold set in the MMT board driver, or overtemperature was detected on the driver
933.resolution: Verify the connection and wiring of the Brush Motor on the MMT board.

934.error_description: Internal overtemperature in the Tinting Pump stepper motor controller
934.resolution: Switch off the machine, wait a few minutes, and switch it on again. If the problem persists, verify the electrical connections to the Pump stepper motor. If the problem still persists, replace the MMT board.

935.error_description: Internal overtemperature in the Tinting Valve stepper motor controller
935.resolution: Switch off the machine, wait a few minutes, and switch it on again. If the problem persists, verify the electrical connections to the Valve stepper motor. If the problem still persists, replace the MMT board.

936.error_description: Internal overtemperature in the Tinting Table stepper motor controller
936.resolution: Switch off the machine, wait a few minutes, and switch it on again. If the problem persists, verify the electrical connections to the Table stepper motor. If the problem still persists, replace the MMT board.

937.error_description: Gate control voltage too low in the Tinting Pump stepper motor controller
937.resolution: Verify the electrical connections to the Pump stepper motor. If the problem persists, replace the MMT board.

938.error_description: Gate control voltage too low in the Tinting Valve stepper motor controller
938.resolution: Verify the electrical connections to the Valve stepper motor. If the problem persists, replace the MMT board.

939.error_description: Gate control voltage too low in the Tinting Table stepper motor controller
939.resolution: Verify the electrical connections to the Table stepper motor. If the problem persists, replace the MMT board.

940.error_description: CRC fault in the positional table of the circuits on the Tinting Table stored in the MMT board EEPROM
940.resolution: Perform Tinting Table Self-Learning. If the problem persists, replace the MMT board.

941.error_description: The Tinting Table photocell is not engaged when it should be engaged during one or more machine processes

942.error_description: Generic error in Tinting Table movement, or the Table moved during Refill without engaging any circuit

943.resolution: Check operation of the two Valve photocells and the Valve stepper motor wiring.

944.error_description: The Open Valve photocell did not engage during Valve HOMING, during Recirculation, during Valve opening before refilling, or during dosing
944.resolution: Check operation of the two Valve photocells and the Valve stepper motor wiring.

945.error_description: The Tinting Pump engagement photocell did not engage after movement for circuit engagement at the beginning of Recirculation or Dosing
945.resolution: Check operation and wiring of the engagement photocell.

946.error_description: The Brush HOME photocell is not engaged during movements for machine Reset, Tinting Table movement, or a Cleaning process
946.resolution: Check operation of the photocell, Brush DC motor, and motor wiring on the MMT board.

947.error_description: The Cleaning process parameters are incorrect, as detected during machine Reset
947.resolution: Check the Cleaning process parameters and, if necessary, send them again with the DIAG_COLORANT_ACTIVATION_CLEANING command.

948.error_description: EEPROM operation test performed during machine Reset failed
948.resolution: Try again and, if the problem persists, replace the MMT board.

984.error_description: The position or configuration of circuit C1 detected at the end of Tinting Table Homing does not match the Self-Learning data stored in the MMT board EEPROM, or the positional data for circuit C1 differs from the expected value by more than the configured tolerance
984.resolution: Verify Tinting Table photocell operation. Repeat the Self-Learning procedure, verify that circuit C1 is physically present on the Table and matches the software configuration, increase the tolerance for circuit positions if necessary, and send the Tinting Table parameter setting command again.
